release.notes: Adds local SHS Grades with subject presets, reviewed activity and approved exam scores, verified SY 2026-2027 adjusted transmutation, finalized Term 1-3 grade entry, draft print and CSV. Entered term grades are never transmuted again or overwritten by activity-score edits. Blank scores require review instead of counting as zero. Includes pending student-portal group publishing, masked groupmates and roles, updated portal sign-in, Talino website icon and date-limited seasonal styling. Publish selected sections again after installing to include saved groups. Existing records, settings, activation and student access codes are preserved. Grades stay local and are not published to the portal. No classroom records upload automatically; publishing credentials are not bundled.
